verses.zh: 天使又指示我在城内街道当中一道生命水的河，明亮如水晶，从　神和羔羊的宝座流出来。
verses.en: Then[NOTE:1] the angel[NOTE:2] showed me the river of the water of life—water as clear as crystal—pouring out[NOTE:3] from the throne of God and of the Lamb,
notes: Here καί (kai) has been translated as “then” to indicate the implied sequence within the narrative.
Grk “he”; the referent (the angel mentioned in 21:9, 15) has been specified in the translation for clarity.
Grk “proceeding.” Water is more naturally thought to pour out or flow out in English idiom.

verses.zh: 在河这边与那边有生命树，结十二样（或译：回）果子，每月都结果子；树上的叶子乃为医治万民。
verses.en: flowing down the middle of the city’s[NOTE:1] main street.[NOTE:2] On each side[NOTE:3] of the river is the tree of life producing 12 kinds[NOTE:4] of fruit, yielding its fruit every month of the year.[NOTE:5] Its leaves are for the healing of the nations.
notes: Grk “its”; the referent (the city, the new Jerusalem) has been specified in the translation for clarity.
The Greek word πλατεῖα (plateia) refers to a major (broad) street (L&N 1.103).
Grk “From here and from there.”
Or “twelve crops” (one for each month of the year).
The words “of the year” are implied.

verses.zh: 以后再没有咒诅；在城里有　神和羔羊的宝座；他的仆人都要事奉他，
verses.en: And there will no longer be any curse,[NOTE:1] and the throne of God and the Lamb will be in the city.[NOTE:2] His[NOTE:3] servants[NOTE:4] will worship[NOTE:5] him,
notes: Or “be anything accursed” (L&N 33.474).
Grk “in it”; the referent (the city, the new Jerusalem) has been specified in the translation for clarity.
Grk “city, and his.” Although this is a continuation of the previous sentence in Greek, a new sentence was started here in the translation because of the introduction of the Lamb’s followers.
See the note on the word “servants” in 1:1.
Or “will serve.”

verses.zh: 也要见他的面。他的名字必写在他们的额上。
verses.en: and they will see his face, and his name will be on their foreheads.

verses.zh: 不再有黑夜；他们也不用灯光、日光，因为主　神要光照他们。他们要作王，直到永永远远。
verses.en: Night will be no more, and they will not need the light of a lamp or the light of the sun, because the Lord God will shine on them, and they will reign forever and ever.

verses.zh: 天使又对我说：「这些话是真实可信的。主就是众先知被感之灵的　神，差遣他的使者，将那必要快成的事指示他仆人。」
verses.en: Then[NOTE:1] the angel[NOTE:2] said to me, “These words are reliable[NOTE:3] and true. The Lord, the God of the spirits of the prophets, has sent his angel to show his servants[NOTE:4] what must happen soon.”
notes: Here καί (kai) has been translated as “then” to indicate the implied sequence within the narrative.
Grk “he”; the referent (the angel mentioned in 21:9, 15; 22:1) has been specified in the translation for clarity.
Grk “faithful.”
See the note on the word “servants” in 1:1.

verses.zh: 「看哪，我必快来！凡遵守这书上预言的有福了！」
verses.en: (Look ! I am coming soon!Blessed is the one who keeps the words of the prophecy expressed in this book.)[NOTE:1]
notes: These lines are parenthetical, forming an aside to the narrative. The speaker here is the Lord Jesus Christ himself rather than the narrator.

verses.zh: 这些事是我－约翰所听见、所看见的；我既听见、看见了，就在指示我的天使脚前俯伏要拜他。
verses.en: I, John, am the one who heard and saw these things,[NOTE:1] and when I heard and saw them,[NOTE:2] I threw myself down[NOTE:3] to worship at the feet of the angel who was showing them to me.
notes: Or “I am John, the one who heard and saw these things.”
The pronoun “them” is not in the Greek text, but is implied. Direct objects were frequently omitted in Greek when clear from the context.
Grk “I fell down and worshiped at the feet.” BDAG 815 s.v. πίπτω 1.b.α.ב. has “fall down, throw oneself to the ground as a sign of devotion or humility, before high-ranking persons or divine beings.”

verses.zh: 他对我说：「千万不可！我与你和你的弟兄众先知，并那些守这书上言语的人，同是作仆人的。你要敬拜　神。」
verses.en: But[NOTE:1] he said to me, “Do not do this![NOTE:2] I am a fellow servant[NOTE:3] with you and with your brothers the prophets, and with those who obey[NOTE:4] the words of this book. Worship God!”
notes: Here καί (kai) has been translated as “but” to indicate the contrast present here.
On the elliptical expression ὅρα μή (hora mē) BDAG 720 s.v. ὁράω B.2 states: “Elliptically…ὅρα μή (sc. ποιήσῃς) watch out! don’t do that! Rv 19:10; 22:9.”

Grk “fellow slave.” Though σύνδουλος (sundoulos) is here translated “fellow servant,” the word does not bear the connotation of a free individual serving another. See the note on the word “servants” in 1:1.
Grk “keep” (an idiom for obedience).

verses.zh: 他又对我说：「不可封了这书上的预言，因为日期近了。
verses.en: Then[NOTE:1] he said to me, “Do not seal up the words of the prophecy contained in this book, because the time is near.
notes: Here καί (kai) has been translated as “then” to indicate the implied sequence of events within the vision.

verses.zh: 不义的，叫他仍旧不义；污秽的，叫他仍旧污秽；为义的，叫他仍旧为义；圣洁的，叫他仍旧圣洁。」
verses.en: The evildoer must continue to do evil,[NOTE:1] and the one who is morally filthy[NOTE:2] must continue to be filthy. The[NOTE:3] one who is righteous must continue to act righteously, and the one who is holy must continue to be holy.”
notes: Grk “must do evil still.”
For this translation see L&N 88.258; the term refers to living in moral filth.
Grk “filthy, and the.” This is a continuation of the previous sentence in Greek, but because of the length and complexity of the construction a new sentence was started in the translation.

verses.zh: 「看哪，我必快来！赏罚在我，要照各人所行的报应他。
verses.en: (Look ! I am coming soon, and my reward is with me to pay[NOTE:1] each one according to what he has done!
notes: The Greek term may be translated either “pay” or “pay back” and has something of a double meaning here. However, because of the mention of “wages” (“reward,” another wordplay with two meanings) in the previous clause, the translation “pay” for ἀποδοῦναι (apodounai) was used here.

verses.zh: 我是阿拉法，我是俄梅戛；我是首先的，我是末后的；我是初，我是终。」
verses.en: I am the Alpha and the Omega, the first and the last, the beginning and the end!)[NOTE:1]
notes: These lines are parenthetical, forming an aside to the narrative. The speaker here is the Lord Jesus Christ himself rather than the narrator.

verses.zh: 那些洗净自己衣服的有福了！可得权柄能到生命树那里，也能从门进城。
verses.en: Blessed are those who wash their robes so they can have access[NOTE:1] to the tree of life and can enter into the city by the gates.
notes: Grk “so that there will be to them authority over the tree of life.”

verses.zh: 城外有那些犬类、行邪术的、淫乱的、杀人的、拜偶像的，并一切喜好说谎言、编造虚谎的。
verses.en: Outside are the dogs and the sorcerers[NOTE:1] and the sexually immoral, and the murderers, and the idolaters and everyone who loves and practices falsehood![NOTE:2]
notes: On the term φάρμακοι (pharmakoi) see L&N 53.101.
Or “lying,” “deceit.”

verses.zh: 「我―耶稣差遣我的使者为众教会将这些事向你们证明。我是大卫的根，又是他的后裔。我是明亮的晨星。」
verses.en: “I, Jesus, have sent my angel to testify to you about these things for the churches. I am the root and the descendant of David, the bright morning star!”[NOTE:1]
notes: On this expression BDAG 892 s.v. πρωϊνός states, “early, belonging to the morning ὁ ἀστὴρ ὁ πρ. the morning star, Venus Rv 2:28; 22:16.”

verses.zh: 圣灵和新妇都说：「来！」听见的人也该说：「来！」口渴的人也当来；愿意的，都可以白白取生命的水喝。
verses.en: And the Spirit and the bride say, “Come!” And let the one who hears say: “Come!” And let the one who is thirsty come; let the one who wants it take the water of life free of charge.

verses.zh: 我向一切听见这书上预言的作见证，若有人在这预言上加添甚么，　神必将写在这书上的灾祸加在他身上；
verses.en: I testify to everyone who hears the words of the prophecy contained in this book: If anyone adds to them, God will add to him the plagues described[NOTE:1] in this book.
notes: Grk “written.”

verses.zh: 这书上的预言，若有人删去甚么，　神必从这书上所写的生命树和圣城删去他的分。
verses.en: And if anyone takes away from the words of this book of prophecy, God will take away his share in the tree of life[NOTE:1] and in the holy city that are described in this book.
notes: The Textus Receptus, on which the KJV rests, reads “the book” of life (ἀπὸ βίβλου, apo biblou) instead of “the tree” of life. When the Dutch humanist Desiderius Erasmus translated the NT he had access to no Greek mss for the last six verses of Revelation. So he translated the Latin Vulgate back into Greek at this point. As a result he created seventeen textual variants which were not in any Greek mss. The most notorious of these is this reading. It is thus decidedly inauthentic, while “the tree” of life, found in the best and virtually all Greek mss, is clearly authentic. The confusion was most likely due to an intra-Latin switch: The form of the word for “tree” in Latin in this passage is ligno; the word for “book” is libro. The two-letter difference accounts for an accidental alteration in some Latin mss; that “book of life” as well as “tree of life” is a common expression in the Apocalypse probably accounts for why this was not noticed by Erasmus or the KJV translators. (This textual problem is not discussed in NA27.)

verses.zh: 证明这事的说：「是了，我必快来！」阿们！主耶稣啊，我愿你来！
verses.en: The one who testifies to these things says, “Yes, I am coming soon!” Amen! Come, Lord Jesus!

verses.zh: 愿主耶稣的恩惠常与众圣徒同在。阿们！
verses.en: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with all.[NOTE:1]
notes: Most mss (א M) read “amen” (ἀμήν, amēn) after “all” (πάντων, pantōn). It is, however, not found in other significant mss (A 1006 1841). It is easier to account for its addition than its omission from the text if original. Such a conclusion is routinely added by scribes to NT books because a few of these books originally had such an ending (cf. Rom 16:27; Gal 6:18; Jude 25). A majority of Greek witnesses have the concluding ἀμήν in every NT book except Acts, James, and 3 John (and even in these books, ἀμήν is found in some witnesses). It is thus a predictable variant.
